title: Tunisian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional lamb kebabs, inspired by the flavors of Tunisia and served with a Mexican twist.

ingredients.name: tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets or online

ingredients.name: grilled bell pepper
ingredients.notes: any color, grilled until slightly charred

instructions: Thread lamb cubes, red onion, bell pepper, and cilantro onto kebab skewers.
Brush with Tunisian spice blend and lemon juice.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until lamb is cooked through.
Serve immediately, garnished with toasted cumin seeds and grilled red onion.
